title: Empty room with white walls and a coffered ceiling
workingCropDescription: Full-frame resized working copy retaining the blank left wall, coffered ceiling, skirting, tiled floor and door geometry.
notes: Selected for calibration rather than styling: the wall-ceiling boundary, skirting, tiled floor and door jambs provide multiple independent perspective cues. The JPEG remains LDR, so recovered lighting is an approximation rather than HDR radiance.
